milk: 1Co.9:7. Metaphorical, of elementary Christian teaching: 1Co.3:2, Heb.5:12, 13; τὸ λογικὸν ἄδολον γ., the rational (spiritual) genuine milk (see Hort, in l.), 1Pe.2:2 (in support of AV, milk of the word, see ICC, in l.).†

elsewhere.note: I fed you with milk, not with meat; for you weren’t yet ready. Indeed, you aren’t ready even now,
For although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first principles of the revelations of God. You…
as newborn babies, long for the pure milk of the Word, that with it you may grow,
